title: Claude Opus 4.8: Same Price, 4x More Honest & Hundreds of Parallel Agents
description:
Anthropic just dropped Claude Opus 4.8 — same price as before, but two things in it actually change what you can hand off without watching. 

It's 4x less likely to let broken code slide past you, and it can now spin up hundreds of parallel subagents in one Claude Code session. 

Same price. Less babysitting. 

#claudeopus #aiagents #anthropic #aiautomation #claudecode
